articles.title: The Battalion and Gold approved for DCI’s World Class in 2027
Steve Vickers, longtime publisher of Drum Corps World, dies at 77
Mandarins approved to return to the 2027 DCI Tour
Ensembles from five countries will be represented at 2026 European Drum Corps Championships
The road back to Finals: 2026 Spirit of Atlanta

items.blurb: Audition materials for The Academy are now available.
The Battalion was approved to join DCI’s World Class division in 2027. “This is a culmination of everything we’ve been building over the last 12 years,” Battalion director Tyler Hess said.
The Blue Devils are hosting a brass audition camp Sunday, October 4 in Norcross, Georgia.
Blue Knights’ audition camp schedule and details on virtual auditions are available now.
Bluecoats is looking to hire an assistant tour manager.
Carolina Crown is hiring a fall merchandise sales assistant for events in October.
Colts announced its 2027 caption leadership team.
Eclipse is hiring for multiple admin and operations positions.

Gold was approved to transition to DCI’s World Class beginning in 2027. “Moving into World Class is a big moment for Gold. It’s something we’ve been working toward for a long time, even if it wasn’t always the immediate goal in front of us,” Gold executive director Kevin Valentine said.
Travis Larson was announced as the Guardians’ brass composer and arranger for 2027.

Mandarins announced Jeff Pearson as its corps director. “His extensive experience in drum corps operations, organizational leadership, human resources, and business management will be an important part of building a successful and sustainable future for the corps.”
Phantom Regiment unveiled its slate of audition camp locations.
River City Rhythm is searching for an assistant corps director.
Seattle Cascades is looking for media team members to document its 2027 season.
Spartans, Boston Crusaders and 7th Regiment are teaming up for a free, single-day brass clinic with staff from all three corps in Reading, Massachusetts.
Spirit introduced its 2027 design team.
Troopers announced the title of its 2027 production: “America’s Core.”

Zephyrus has tapped Darin Williams as its new corps director. “Without the support I have received from loving family, supportive friends, and cherished colleagues I would not be ready to begin this exciting journey,” Williams said.
Bushwackers shared its board of directors roster for the 2027 season.
Registration for Cincinnati Tradition’s 2027 season is now open on the corps’ website.
Columbus Saints audition registration and materials are available now ahead of the corps’ October 18 and 25 educational clinics.
Fusion Core announced its 2027 board of directors and admin team.
Meet the Hawthorne Caballeros 2027 administrative team.
Late Northern Lights co-founder and Hall of Fame member Daniel Meyers was honored with the naming of a rehearsal space at Muskegon Community College.
Reading Buccaneers announced its 2027 caption leadership.
Prospective corps members can fill out the Sunrisers’ 2027 interest form.

items.corps: Blue Saints Drum & Bugle Corps – Sudbury, ON
items.blurb: The Blue Saints will help kick off the Sudbury Walk for Down Syndrome Awareness in Sudbury, Ontario.
Carolina Gold is hiring instructors and staff in a variety of areas within the corps.

items.corps: Crusaders Senior Drum & Bugle Corps – Boston, MA
items.blurb: Crusaders Senior Corps has spots available in every section ahead of an October 4 event.

Sky Ryders named Jay Koupal as corps director. “Jay brings a rare combination of educational leadership, marching-arts experience, and a deep commitment to young performers,” said Sky Ryders Performing Arts Foundation CEO Dale Antoine.
Arsenal announced audition camps in multiple Texas cities.
Blue Devils announced dates and locations for its 2027 audition camps.

Blue Knights promoted James Barnes to the position of executive director. “James brings the experience, character and commitment to excellence needed to advance the Blue Knights’ mission while honoring the proud tradition of service to youth through the pursuit of excellence in life and the performing arts,” Ascend Performing Arts CEO Mark Arnold said.
Bluecoats’ 2027 audition packets are now available for purchase.
The Inspire Arts & Music Board of Directors recently held its annual meeting, planning its upcoming year of programming, including the Boston Crusaders
Carolina Crown’s 2026 design and caption leadership teams will return for the 2027 season.
Tony Hall was announced as the Colts’ new program director.
Crossmen announced its caption heads for the 2027 season.
Eclipse is hiring an ensemble coordinator and percussion coordinator for the 2027 season.

After a one-year hiatus, Mandarins announced the approval of the corps to return to the field for the 2027 DCI Tour. “2027 will be a transformational year for the drum corps as we build our teams to provide an exceptional experience for our corps members,” executive director JW Koester said.
Memphis Blues set an audition camp date for December 4-6, 2026.
Music City shared the passing of longtime supporter and friend of the corps, Marilyn Weldin.
Phantom Regiment is looking for audio engineers and interns to join the corps for the 2027 season.
Raiders’ recruiting team will be at the Herndon Showcase of Bands in Herndon, Virginia on Saturday, September 26.
River City Rhythm is hiring for educational staff positions in all captions.
Early bird registration for 2027 Vanguard auditions is now open.
Seattle Cascades announced its caption leadership for the 2027 season.
Bushwackers will have recruitment materials available at multiple events in Pennsylvania and New Jersey this fall.
Cincinnati Tradition announced changes in its leadership, with Andrea Meyer serving as the corps’ executive director and Bryce Hopwood taking over the corps director role.
Govenaires announced its new board of directors heading into the corps’ milestone 100th anniversary season.
Registration is now open for Hawthorne Caballeros’ open house weekend, November 28 and 29 in Wayne, New Jersey.
Northern Lights announced updates to its leadership and educational staff, including the appointment of John Meehan as program coordinator.
Reading Buccaneers announced its design team for the 2027 season.

items.corps: Bluecoats Rhythm IN BLUE Canton, OH
items.blurb: Rhythm in Blue and the Bluecoats shared news of the passing of four-year Rhythm IN BLUE performer Steven Petrey.
Calgary Stampede played a fun part in “The Amazing Race Canada’s” season 12 finale.

Sky Ryders appointed Dale Antoine as its new CEO. “Dale’s longstanding commitment to the Sky Ryders, combined with his extensive experience across the drum corps activity, makes him exceptionally well suited to lead the foundation,” said Sean Wheeler, Sky Ryders Performing Arts Foundation Board President.
Sonus will have a recruiting team at the Woodbridge Invitational in Woodbridge, Virginia on October 3.
The ConneXion invited prospective members to fill out an interest form ahead of recruitment events on September 26 and 27.

Earlier this month The Academy welcomed Kelsey Brunson as corps director. “Kelsey’s exceptional track record in higher ed leadership, music education, and her dedication to fostering excellence and innovation will be invaluable as we continue to build on The Academy’s legacy of inspiring and empowering the next generation of performers,” Academy board chair Matt Chamberlain said.
The Blue Devils announced the members of the corps’ 2027 design and visual teams.
Blue Knights announced its 2027 design team.
Registration is now open for Blue Stars’ 2027 audition camps.
Bluecoats are hiring for a variety of positions, including photographer and a new philanthropy-focused role.
Boston Crusaders’ 2027 audition packet is available for purchase.

Colts tapped Kathleen Ballard as its new corps director. “Kathleen brings incredible skills, experience, and continuity we’ve been striving for and helps move the organization forward seamlessly,” said Colts executive director Vicki MacFarlane.

Crossmen named John Meehan as its new corps director. “During his first season with the Crossmen, he made an exceptional impact and demonstrated a deep commitment to the development and experience of our performers, as well as the continued growth of the organization,” board of directors president David Borland said.
Gold’s interest form for 2027 prospective members is now open.
Guardians is hiring for positions in all areas of the corps’ operations.
Pacific Crest announced its audition camp schedule and opened registration for those events.
Registration is now open for Phantom Regiment’s 2027 auditions.
Vanguard encouraged prospective members to fill out the corps’ 2027 interest form.
Seattle Cascades’ audition interest form is open for sign-ups.
Troopers announced its caption management team for the 2027 season.
Bushwackers’ 2027 caption manager roster includes both new and familiar faces.
Hawthorne Caballeros’ entire team of caption heads returns for the corps’ 2027 season.
Reading Buccaneers announced its 2027 recruitment event schedule.
Sunrisers is hiring for a new business manager role on the corps’ admin team.
